doc.title: Ira Gitler interviewed by Michael Woods, New York City, New York, November 16, 1995

title: Dizzy's personality and Teddy Hill's remark
summary: Dizzy's zaniness hid seriousness about music; Teddy Hill called him 'Dizzy like a fox'.

story.theme_name: Charlie Parker, Dizzy and the bebop revolution
story.community_name: Charlie Parker: encounters, lore and legacy

blocks.x: then the pretty ballads. But he was a personality. He was zany, you know, he was everything. But as he once said, “Yeah you know they say that I kid around too much and all that” he says. “but in the music I’m serious.” And some people failed to get past the other part. They only saw the beret and the goatee and the heavy rimmed glasses, and you know Dizzy. But I thought Teddy Hill said it best I think, his ex-leader, he said, “Dizzy like a fox.”
You know, he was always on top of his playing.
So he was always one of my heroes.
